title: 第17章 人手不足第18章 古玩街
content_zh:
反正易长生也习惯了住这个地下室，甚至可以说在地下室里他更有安全感。
特别是这宅院里还有地道通向郊外，万一城里有什么大事发生，这里还有一个逃生通道呢。
想着，他看了一眼齐万才那边，齐万才正和其他学徒一起准备离开田家武馆。
易长生正想着准备做晚饭吃，突然就听到齐万才和其他学徒们聊天中提到了田大小姐，田大小姐被放出来了。
田大小姐的先天功终于突破五层，提升到五重境了吗？
看来计划得改变一下，他要看看田大小姐什么时候出来，再将虚维之眼放在她身上。
她身上的先天功法运转经验易长生还是想学习的。
他一边做饭，一边留意齐万才他们小声的聊天。
“大小姐没有突破吗？”齐万才问道。
“没有。”一个学徒摇头说道。
“我悄悄和你们说，刚才我听到一位师兄说，是田家主好像是要去远行，要大小姐出来暂时看管武馆和家业的。”
“啊，我看到有好几个师兄似乎也要离开。”
“你们最近有收到什么有用的消息吗？”
“嗯，我今天出门时就听到我哥说，冯家似乎也要去远门，好像是要去凤鸣城。”
“去凤鸣城吗？”齐万才心里有疑惑，见同伴们都没有别的消息就只好先回去。
易长生也是一脸的疑惑，没有突破五层就出来？
是发生了什么事了吗？
还是田大小姐待在院子里太久了，想出来散散心？
他一边做饭一边留意着齐家，想看看齐家这边有没有什么新的消息。
等做好饭时，齐万才那边一家人已经吃完饭，然后习惯的在客厅里喝茶闲聊。

齐万才第一时间就把今天回来时听到的消息说给父亲听。
“出远门？周家那边的二公子似乎也要出远门。”齐万才的二哥听了也把自己知道的消息说出来。
齐家主皱了一下眉头，看了一眼大哥的方向问道：“你那边有什么消息？”
“昨天县令家的管事来采买时，似乎有提到要买点路上吃的东西。”齐家大哥说道。
齐家主说：“今天有个熟悉的镖师来吃饭，也和我说了过几天会走一趟凤鸣城的镖。消息不明，但应该不是景松城有什么大事发生，你们明天多打听打听。”
“好。”
“嗯。”
齐万才哥几个都一一应道。
易长生也觉得应该不是景松城有什么大事，而且去凤鸣城，那应该是凤鸣城有什么大事发生，所以景松城里的家族都想去凤鸣城？
第二天，齐万才去到田家武馆时，易长生就进入了全知视角，细细观察田家的异样。
有着齐万才特意的打听，很快就发现了田家家主也是要去凤鸣城，而且听说还是带着小儿子一起去的。
不仅田家，几个有点关系的学徒，也听那几家有特别关系的大户人家，也是准备带着儿子孙子去凤鸣城。
content_en:
Anyway, Yi Changsheng is used to living in this basement. It can even be said that he feels safer in the basement.
Especially in this house, there is a tunnel leading to the suburbs. If something big happens in the city, there is an escape route here.
Thinking about it, he glanced at Qi Wancai, who was preparing to leave the Tianjia Martial Arts School with other apprentices.
Yi Changsheng was thinking about making dinner when he suddenly heard Qi Wancai mentioning Miss Tian while chatting with other apprentices, and Miss Tian was released.
Has Miss Tian's innate skill finally broken through the fifth level and been promoted to the fifth level?
It seemed that the plan had to be changed. He wanted to see when Miss Tian would come out and then put the Eye of Xuwei on her.
Yi Changsheng still wanted to learn from her experience in operating innate skills.
While he was cooking, he paid attention to Qi Wancai and the others chatting quietly.
"Didn't the eldest lady make a breakthrough?" Qi Wancai asked.
"No." An apprentice shook his head and said.
"Let me tell you quietly, I just heard a senior brother say that the head of the Tian family seems to be going on a long trip, and asked the eldest lady to temporarily take care of the martial arts school and family property."
"Ah, I saw that several senior brothers seemed to be leaving."
"Have you received any useful news recently?"
"Well, when I went out today, I heard my brother say that the Feng family seems to be going far away, probably to Fengming City."
"Going to Fengming City?" Qi Wancai was confused. Seeing that his companions had no other news, he had to go back first.
Yi Changsheng also looked puzzled. He came out without breaking through the fifth level?
What happened?
Or has Miss Tian stayed in the yard for too long and wanted to take a break?
While cooking, he kept an eye on the Qi family, wanting to see if there was any new news from the Qi family.
By the time the meal was ready, Qi Wancai's family had already finished their meal and were drinking tea and chatting in the living room as usual.
Qi Wancai immediately told his father the news he heard when he came back today.
"Traveling far away? It seems that the second young master from the Zhou family is also going away." After hearing this, Qi Wancai's second brother also told the news he knew.
The head of the Qi family frowned, glanced in the direction of his eldest brother and asked, "What news do you have over there?"
"When the steward of the county magistrate's family came to buy yesterday, he seemed to have mentioned that he wanted to buy something to eat on the road." The eldest brother of the Qi family said.
The head of the Qi family said: "Today a familiar escort came to dinner, and he told me that he would visit Fengming City in a few days. The news is unknown, but it seems that something big happened in Jingsong City. You can ask more tomorrow."
"Okay."
"Yeah."
Brother Qi Wancai all responded one by one.
Yi Changsheng also felt that it wasn't that something big happened in Jingsong City, and if he went to Fengming City, it should be that something big happened in Fengming City. So all the families in Jingsong City wanted to go to Fengming City?
The next day, when Qi Wancai went to the Tianjia martial arts gym, Yi Changsheng entered the omniscient perspective and carefully observed the strangeness of the Tianjia.
With Qi Wancai's special inquiry, he soon discovered that the head of the Tian family was also going to Fengming City, and it was said that he was taking his young son with him.
Not only the Tian family, but also several apprentices with some connections, and some wealthy families with special connections were also preparing to take their sons and grandsons to Fengming City.
